Net total across the six shards (parent roll-up of the per-shard measured recoveries; positive = comment/docstring lines net recovered/removed, measured by diff on each shard's merged change):

  9ce8 (reconciler subtree, chg 1542):  -3   (net ADD; MOVES not deletes — pagination/cap prose relocated to ADR 0062 + See-ADR citations)
  4fc1 (commands/CLI, chg 1543):       +34   (stale bash-dispatcher narration deleted/relocated to docs/bash-migration.md)
  4b94 (llm core, chg 1544):           +46   (capabilities -30, providers -18, structured +2, runner 0; ADR 0063)
  ad16 (plan_review/workflow, chg 1545): +1   (correction/relocation-dominated; executor.py 791->790; P1-P9->P1-P11; ADRs 0064-0066)
  da4c (store/reducer, chg 1546):      +11   (31 code-comment lines removed vs ~20 added; _version.py changelog -> docs/event-schema.md)
  ab77 (root/services, chg 1547):       -4   (net ADD by design; three rationale blocks homed to ADRs 0067/0068/0069 + one-line citations)
  --------------------------------------------------
  NET TOTAL:                          ~85   comment/docstring lines recovered

This figure is an OUTPUT of the triage, not a target (per the corrected AC and the 9ce8 plan-review ruling: "the number is an output of the work, not an input to it"). It is far below the ~2,033-line pre-triage ESTIMATE precisely because the work was correction- and relocation-dominated rather than deletion-dominated: substantial prose was MOVED verbatim into ADRs 0062-0069 (destination-first, then the inline block collapsed to a one-line citation) rather than deleted, and several shards (ab77, ad16) found their scope already in good health. No relocation was manufactured to reach an estimate; every non-KEEP unit in scope was correctly dispositioned (RELOCATE/DELETE) and every load-bearing unit was recorded on .joe-janitor/tools.md as DO_NOT_MOVE / CORRECT-IN-PLACE. All six shards landed in dependency order (changes 1542-1547) with CI Verified+1; ADRs 0062-0069 exist and were committed before any citing comment was collapsed.
